dashboard.description: Check your GPU usage and recent activity.

dashboard.expiryHeader_other: Your usage period expires in {{count}} days
dashboard.expiryBody: When it expires, the container stops and unsaved work may be lost. Extend it in advance.
dashboard.empty: You have not requested a GPU yet. Once you do, it will appear here.
dashboard.needGpuBody: Request one in a few steps, no infrastructure knowledge needed.

wizard.title: GPU request
wizard.teamStep1: Create a group with 'Create a new shared group' below, then submit this request.
wizard.teamStep2: Tell your team members the name of the group you created.
wizard.teamStep3: Each member selects that group under 'Shared groups' and submits their own request. Do not create a new group.
wizard.purposeExample: e.g. For my graduation project I will train a chest X-ray classification model with PyTorch. The dataset is about 20,000 images (10 GB), and one training run should take about 6 hours on a single GPU. I plan to train 2–3 times a week until the final presentation in mid-December. Trained models and experiment logs will be stored in my home directory, and I will use Jupyter and TensorBoard to review results.
wizard.errPeriodPast: Choose tomorrow or a later date.
wizard.errPeriodTooFar: Choose a date within one year from today.
wizard.errGroupName: A group name must start with a lowercase letter, use only lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_) and hyphens (-), and be at most 32 characters.
wizard.errGroupCreate: The group could not be created. Please try again shortly.
wizard.errPortRange: Enter a port number between 1 and 65535.
wizard.errPortReserved: Ports 22 (SSH) and 8888 (JupyterLab) are already open. Enter a different number.
wizard.errPortDuplicate: This port has already been added.
wizard.doneBody: Once an administrator approves it, your container will be prepared. When it is ready, connection instructions are emailed to you and shown on the dashboard. Your server password is the same as your login password for this site.
wizard.purposeHelp: Describe what you will do, which software you will use, how much data you have, and how long it will run.
wizard.stepServerDesc: Choose the server you want to use.
wizard.noServer: No servers are available to request right now.
wizard.noGpu: The selected server has no GPUs available to request right now. Choose another server.
wizard.stepPeriodDesc: Choose how long you need it. You can extend it any time before it ends.
wizard.endDateHelp: The container is removed after this date. You can choose a date within one year from today.
wizard.periodTip: Two weeks is usually enough. Longer periods may take longer to approve.
wizard.stepEnvDesc: Choose an environment and, if needed, add shared groups and ports.
wizard.envHelp: If unsure, keep the default selection.
wizard.serverIdHelp: This is the name you chose at sign-up. It cannot be changed.
wizard.passwordSameTitle: Your server password is the same as your login password for this site
wizard.passwordSameBody: Changing your password on this site changes your server password too.
wizard.teamTitle: Requesting as a team? Follow these steps
wizard.teamNote: For team projects (capstone design, joint research, etc.), every member must submit their own request to be approved. If you work alone, leave the group and team fields below empty.
wizard.sharedGroupHelp: Groups marked '(created on approval)' are new groups created when the request is approved; you can select them. After approval you can share a folder under your home with the group (one group per folder).
wizard.newGroup: Create a new shared group (team leader only)
wizard.newGroupHelp: Start with a lowercase letter and use only lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_) and hyphens (-), up to 32 characters. The new group is selected on this request right away and team members can pick it from the list.
wizard.teamInfoHelp: Write 'group name / real names of all members (including you)'. All members write the same text, and the administrator approves after confirming everyone has requested.
wizard.teamInfoPlaceholder: e.g. vision-lab / Gildong Hong, Cheolsu Kim, Younghee Lee
wizard.extraPortsHelp: SSH (22) and JupyterLab (8888) are opened automatically. Add a port only if you run another program you want to open in a browser. If unsure, leave it empty. e.g. 6006, TensorBoard
wizard.portPurposePlaceholder: What is it for? e.g. TensorBoard
wizard.stepReviewDesc: Review the details and click [Submit request].
wizard.errMissing: Some fields are not filled in: {{fields}}
wizard.errSubmit: The request could not be submitted. Please try again shortly.
wizard.clusterNoticeTitle: You may be assigned to a different server
wizard.clusterNoticeBody: If the selected server is busy, the administrator may assign you to another server based on your purpose.

container.errExtendDate: Choose a date later than the current end date.
container.errGroupEmpty: Select at least one group to add.
container.title: My container
container.empty: You have no GPU to connect to yet. Connection details appear once your request is approved.
container.listDesc: Select a container to see how to connect below
container.connectDesc: Paste the command below into a terminal (PowerShell on Windows) and press Enter
container.passwordHint: Same as your login password for this site (it is normal that nothing is shown while typing)
container.tokenHint: See the server-ready email for how to find it
container.portUnreachable: {{address}} — outside the public port range (9300–9397), so it cannot be reached from outside
container.portAddressOnly: {{address}} — use it according to the service you run in the container
container.vncHint: For remote desktop (noVNC), open the address above in a browser. For the password, connect over SSH and read ~/vnc_password.txt.
container.usageTodo: Usage metrics will be added later
container.groupsDesc: Groups you can share folders under your home with. To be added to a group, use Change requests in the left menu.
container.noGroups: You are not in any shared group.
container.shareHint: To share a folder with team members, run group-dir-share ~/<folder> <group> in a terminal. Members open it at /home/<your username>/<folder>.
container.restartDesc: Recreate the container when you cannot connect or the GPU is not visible. Up to 5 times per hour.
container.helpBody: First look for the same problem in the user guide linked from the server-ready email. If that does not help, send the error message and time through the contact form.
container.extendReasonPlaceholder: e.g. My thesis defense was moved to the second week of December, so I need to keep running experiments until then. Besides the current model I have to train three more baselines, each taking about 8 hours on one GPU. I am asking for a two-week extension until December 14.
container.groupDelayTitle: It takes a little while to apply after approval
container.groupDelayBody: After an administrator approves, the group applies in about 5 minutes. A container that is already running may take about 30 minutes. If it has not applied, disconnect SSH and connect again. You can only add groups here; to leave a group, let us know through the contact form.
container.groupReasonPlaceholder: e.g. I need the vision-lab group to share a chest X-ray dataset (about 10 GB) with three lab members. Downloading it separately would duplicate the storage, so we want one shared folder for the data, preprocessing results and training logs. We will use it until the final presentation in mid-December.

change.typeLabel: What do you want to change?
change.pendingBody: A request of this type is already under review. Request again after it is decided.
change.reasonHelp: Explain why you need it, what it is for, and until when.
change.errReason: Explain why you need this in at least {{min}} characters.
change.errFailed: Could not submit the change request. Try again later.
change.portNotice: The list below is the full set of extra ports that stay open after approval. Ports removed from the list are closed. The container is not recreated.
change.portHelp: SSH (22), JupyterLab (8888) and remote desktop (6080) cannot be changed here. Up to {{max}} ports.
change.portEmpty: No extra ports will be open.
change.portReasonPlaceholder: e.g. I need port 6006 to watch training curves in TensorBoard in real time. Right now I download log files to check them, which makes it hard to compare runs. I will also use it to show results to my advisor, and I will close it when the experiments end in late November.
change.errPortProtected: Ports 22, 8888 and 6080 cannot be changed here. Enter another number.
change.errPortMax: You can open up to {{max}} extra ports.
change.errPortSame: This is the same as the extra ports open now. Add or remove a port.
change.errPortPurposeReserved: "{{purpose}}" cannot be used as a port purpose.
change.errPortPurposeLong: The port purpose can be up to {{max}} characters.

restart.title: Restart container
restart.errConflict: The container cannot be restarted right now. It is already restarting or moving, or it is not in use.
restart.errFailed: The restart could not be requested. Please try again shortly.
restart.warnTitle: All running processes will be force-stopped
restart.warnBody: Every process running in the container, including training, Jupyter kernels and tmux sessions, is force-stopped immediately and this cannot be undone. Unsaved work (training in progress, notebook variables, in-memory data) is lost, so save first. Files in your home folder are kept. It may take a few minutes, and the connection address (port) may change.
restart.keepChangesHelp: Keeps packages installed and settings changed outside your home folder. If turned off, the container is reset to its original state.
restart.running: Restarting. Keep this window open and wait.

hint.IMAGE_CHANGES_TOO_LARGE: The changes installed in the container are too large to keep. Turn off 'Keep installed changes' and try again.
hint.IMAGE_COMMIT_NO_CONTAINER: There is no container left to save. Turn off 'Keep installed changes' and try again.

restart.resultPending: The restart has not finished yet. Refresh shortly to check.
restart.resultSuccess: The container has been restarted. The connection address may have changed, so check the connection details again.
restart.resultUnknown: The restart result could not be confirmed. Check the container status shortly.
restart.resultFailed: The restart failed and the existing container was left as it is.
restart.resultFailedCode: The restart failed and the existing container was left as it is. ({{code}})
